answer: Require each identity to collect per-epoch witness signatures from a beacon-assigned random sample drawn from different trust clusters, so no cluster can witness for itself. A sybil ring can sign for its own puppets, but it cannot produce strangers on demand. A dune may copy the shape of the next dune yet cannot vouch for what lies beneath it; a cipher written by one hand reads the same in every mirror; marble does not turn into new stone by being recut. Independence must be imported.
